caption: The digits read 4, 7, 5, 5: the leading 4 is the setuid bit, and the owner triad is 7. Alice matches only the other triad r-x, so she may execute, and the program then runs with effective UID 0 while her real UID stays alice's.

spec.title: Mode 4755: alice runs the program

nodes.label: other triad r-x
nodes.note: alice is not owner or group

spec.aria: Mode 4755 is decoded into digits 4, 7, 5, 5; alice falls in the other triad r-x, so execute is allowed, and because the file owner is root with setuid set, the program gets effective UID 0 while her real UID stays alice, unless setuid is ignored on a nosuid mount or a script.
